capabilities: assign a configurable leader key via the Hotkeys settings page
trigger any Obsidian command with a leader key sequence
map commands added by other plugins
extras: README warns the plugin is experimental and may contain bugs that delete data in the current note, advising backups; also notes that release 0.2.0 requires reconfiguring hotkeys.
problem: Obsidian hotkeys are single flat shortcuts, so there is no built-in way to use a prefix key to trigger commands.
summary: Leader-key hotkey plugin that lets any Obsidian command be triggered by a leader key prefix followed by a keystroke, as in tmux or Vim.
